paite: Aisan nihveina Simeon suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi. Atantuam uh Judah suante tantuam lak ah atel hi.
heading: Simeon Gam Tan

paite: Atantuam ding ua pukte Beer-sheba, Sheba, Moladah,
Hazar-shual, Balah, Ezem,
Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
Ziklag, Beth-markaboth. Hazar-susah,
Beth-lebaoth leh Sharuhen; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm-le-thum ahi.
Ain, Rimmon, Ether leh Ashan: akhotate toh khopi li.
Huai khopi kim akhopel tengteng Baalath-beer simlam a Ramah apha hi. Huaite Simeon suante a-inkuan uh dungzui a amau tantuam dia seh ahi.
Simeon suante tantuam Judah suante tantuam lak a ahi. Judah suante tantuam amau a ding in aza lo ngal a; huaiziak in Simeon suante tantuam lak ah atel hi.
Aisan thumveina Zebulun suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi. Atantuam gamgi uh Sarid tan ahi.
heading: Zebulun Gam Tan

paite: Agamgi uh tumlam pang ah Maralah pha in apai a, Dabeseth ava tung a; Jokneam kiang a luita tan ava tung hi.
Sarid a pan suahlam pang nisuahna lam ah Kisloth-tabor gamgi pha in akawitou a; Daberath ah apawt hi.
Huai a pan suahlam pang ah Gittah-hepher leh Eth-kazin ah apai zel a, Neah lam zuan in Rimmon ah apawt hi.
Mallam ah Hannathon ah akualphei nawn a, apawtna Iphtah-el Phaizang ah ahi.
Katath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah leh Bethlehem; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm- le-nih ahi.
Hiaite ahi Zebulun suante a-inkuan uh dungzui a, atantuam ding ua seh; huai khopite leh khopelte toh.
Aisan liveina Issakar suante tung ah a-inkuan uh omdan dungzui in apuk hi.
heading: Issakar Gam Tan

paite: Agamgi chiang uh Jezreel, Kesuloth, Shunem,
Haphraim, Shion, Anaharath,
Rabbith, Kishion, Abez,
Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah leh Beth-pazzez tan ahi.
Tabor, Shahazimah leh Beth-shemesh ava pha a; apawtna Jordan ah ahi a, akhopel teng toh khopi tengteng sawm-le-guk ahi,
Hiaite ahi Issakar suante nam a-inkuan uh dungzui a, atantuam ding ua seh; khopite leh akhotate toh.
Aisan ngana Asher suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi.
heading: Asher Gam Tan

paite: Gamgi chiang Helkath, Hali, Beten, Akshaph,
Allammelek, Amad leh Mishal ahi a; tumlam pang ah Karmel tang leh Shihor-libnath aphasuk hi.
Nisuahna lam pang ah Beth-dagon akualtou a, Zebulun leh mallam pang ah Jiphthah-el Phaizang ah Beth-emek leh Neiel ava pha a; veilam ah Kabul pha in apai a,
Ebron leh Rehob, Hammon leh Kanah, Zidon thupi pha in apai zel hi.
Gamgi Ramah leh Tura khopi kulhbaang nei ah akualphei a, Hosah ah akualphei nawn a, Akzib gam tuipi ah apawt hi.
Ummah, Aphek leh Rehob; akhopel teng toh khopi tengteng sawmnih-le-nih ahi.
Huaite ahi Asher suante nam a-inkuan uh dungzui a, khopite leh akhotate atantuam uh.
Aisan gukna Naphtali suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi.
heading: Naphtali Gam Tan

paite: Agamgi chiang uh Heleph leh Zaananim a singkung lianpi a pan Adami-nekeb, Jabneel leh Lakkum pha in apai a, Jordan ah atawp hi.
Tumlam pang ah Aznoth-tabor ah apaisuk a; huai a pan Hukok ah apai a, simlam ah Zebulun ava tung a, tumlam ah Asher atung a, nisuahna lam ah Judia gam a Jordan aphatou hi.
Khopi kulhbaang neite: Ziddim, Zer, Hamath, Rakkath, Kinneret,
Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,
Kedesh, Edrei, En-hazor,
Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anath leh Beth-shemesh ahi a, akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm ahi.
Hiaite ahi Naphtali suante nam a-inkuan dungzui ua khopite leh akhotate atantuam uh.
Aisan sagihna Dan suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi.
heading: Dan Gam Tan

paite: Atantuam gamgi uh Zorah, Estaol leh Ir-shemesh,
Shaalabbin, Aijalon leh Jethlah,
Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,
Jehud, Bene-berak, Gath-rimmon,
Me-jarkon, Rakkon leh Joppa kiang a gamgi toh.
Dan suante gamgi in huaite ava kheng a; Dan suante'n Lesem adou ua, ala ua, namsau in ahihmang ua, atangta uh. Huai ah ateng pah ua, apu uh Dan min tam in Lesem, Dan ana chi uhi.
Hiaite ahi Dan suante nam a-inkuan uh dungzui a, huai khopi leh akhotate toh atantuam uh.
Huchi in atantuam ding ua gamgi bawl bang zel a gam ahawm khit un, Israel suante'n Nun tapa Joshua alak uah tantuam abawlsak uhi.
heading: Gam Hawmna Nanung

paite: TOUPA thupiak bang in Ephraim singtang gam a, akhopi ding in anget mah Timnath-serah apia ua; ama'n khopi asat a, huai ah ateng hi.

Hiaite ahi siampu Eleazar, Nun tapa Joshua leh Israel suante nam inkuan a lupente'n Shiloh a TOUPA ma a kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a ai san a, agoutan ding ua ana hawmte uh. Huchi in gam kihawm azouta uhi.
